items.title: Elder Sanctum & New Species Coming Soon
items.content: Seat your stage 4+ totems in the Elder Sanctum for daily passive Essence and solo advisory missions. Plus, 4 new species — Turtle, Bear, Raven & Snake — are on the way!

items.title: Expeditions & Challenges Are Live!
items.content: Send 3-totem teams on 15 expeditions across Earth, Water & Air domains. Tackle 10 skill-based challenge mini-games to earn XP, happiness, and Essence rewards.

items.title: Guided Tutorial & Achievement System
items.content: New players can follow a 6-step guided tutorial with reward claims at each milestone. Plus, track your progress across 25+ achievements as you grow your collection.

items.title: Join Our Discord Community
items.content: Connect with other Totem Keepers, get tips, and participate in exclusive events!

items.title: Welcome to TotemBound Beta!
items.content: Explore the world of spiritual companions and start your journey as a Totem Keeper. Raise, train, and evolve 12 mystical species across 5 stages.
